mechanism: Amphetamine's CNS stimulant effects may lower seizure threshold while brivaracetam is an anticonvulsant, creating opposing pharmacodynamic effects; both drugs affect CNS function and amphetamine may reduce brivaracetam's efficacy.
action: Monitor seizure control closely; brivaracetam dose adjustment may be necessary; assess whether amphetamine use is essential given seizure disorder; counsel patient on seizure warning signs.
